summary: Build practical safety compliance, risk, audit, and legal documentation skills across five applied training days. Enquire with TrainingCred.
lede: Health and safety compliance training helps safety managers and compliance officers assess hazards and document workplace controls. It also supports operations supervisors and contract managers with risk registers, hierarchy-of-controls decisions, permit and contractor risk mapping, incident investigation, legal obligation tracking, audit evidence preparation and corrective action planning.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who make, verify, document, or govern workplace safety decisions across operational environments. It is designed for intermediate practitioners who already encounter safety procedures, incidents, audits, or compliance obligations and need a more consistent method for controlling risk and preserving evidence.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of workplace safety procedures, incident reporting, or operational risk controls is expected. You should have access to examples of safety records, such as risk assessments, incident forms, audit findings, or contractor controls, where organizational confidentiality permits. No programming is required. Spreadsheet experience is useful for the digital dashboard exercise, Power BI configuration is introduced at an operational rather than engineering level.
